Index is held in memory and rebuilt at open from the store's append-only journal.
Term-at-a-time: BM25 is accumulated into a per-slot score table, without WAND or MaxScore pruning.
Postings are LEB128 varints of (slot delta, frequency) per term.
Top-k is selected with a bounded heap over the scored slots.
COUNT marks the matching slots of every query term in a bit set and counts each document once.
